$comment: Every *Hash/*Hashes field declared under packages/protocol/schemas, and how its value is derived. Checked by apps/worker/__tests__/unit/hash-field-registry.test.ts. kind: hmac|digest|chain name a producer that exists in the named file; debt cites an issue for a field that holds a plain value today. plainValueSites lists each write site that assigns a plain value, with the reason: a new one fails the test.

contactHash.derivation: A conversation's contactIdentifierHash (HMAC under the messaging hash key), under the name the contact timeline API uses.

contactIdentifierHash.derivation: HMAC-SHA256 of the contact's phone or handle under the messaging hash key (messagingContactHash).

plainValueSites.why: A report's contact is the reporter, written as their pubkey (#3118).
The firehose agent's pubkey stands in for a contact (#3118).

currentHash.derivation: SHA-256 of the evidence file as it is now, presented for comparison against integrityHash.

entryHash.derivation: SHA-256 over the audit entry's canonical bytes and the previous entry's hash (computeEntryHash), or a sigchain link's own hash.

eventTypeHash.derivation: Meant to be an HMAC of the event type; iOS sends the entity type's id, which the server joins to the type's plaintext name (db/schema/entity-type-templates.ts).

producer.why: Holds an entity type id the server can join to the type's plaintext name: hub-level disclosure, already decided: #3025 E1 says the server never stores a type name, and #2191 (D-A) removes it.

identifierHash.derivation: HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical subscriber / signal identifier under the hub's messaging key (messagingContactHash, hashIdentifier) or the signal HMAC key.

identifierHashes.derivation: HMAC blind index of each contact identifier under the hub key (iOS: hmacBlindIndex). The desktop and Android write [] until per-hub index keys (D7/E5).

plainValueSites.why: Dev sample seeder writes phone: + base64(phone), a reversible index of a phone number (#3118).

integrityHash.derivation: SHA-256 of the evidence file's ciphertext, computed by the uploading client (sha256Hex) and compared by the server on verify.

interactionTypeHash.derivation: Meant to be an HMAC of the interaction type; today every writer sends the type itself.

producer.why: Writers send the plain interaction type ('comment', 'status_change', 'note'); low sensitivity, registered as known debt until per-hub index keys (D7/E5).

plainValueSites.why: A status-change entry reuses the client's token; a report conversion writes report_conversion:<id> (#3118).

ipHash.derivation: HMAC-SHA256 of the client IP under HMAC_SECRET (hashIP).

lastIpHash.derivation: The last ipHash seen for a device.

mergedNameHash.derivation: The merged contact's nameHash: same derivation, written by the client that merges.

nameHash.derivation: HMAC blind index of the normalised name under the hub key (iOS: hmacBlindIndex). The desktop and Android write nothing until per-hub index keys (D7/E5).

plainValueSites.why: Dev sample seeder writes base64(lowercased name), a reversible index of a name (#3118).

originalHash.derivation: The stored integrityHash, echoed in the verify answer.

phoneHash.derivation: HMAC-SHA256 of the phone under BAN_HASH_KEY, scoped to the owner (banHash); clients send the OPRF finalize digest (banDigestFinalize), which the server never sees the phone behind.

phoneHashes.derivation: A list of phoneHash values; same producer.

prevHash.derivation: The previous sigchain link's hash (compute_entry_hash in the crate), or the previous audit entry's.

sigchainHash.derivation: The hash of the head sigchain link a device registration carries.

sigchainLinkHash.derivation: The hash of the sigchain link a recovery-group share is bound to.

sigchainPrevHash.derivation: The hash of the sigchain link before the head.

sourcePhoneHash.derivation: A phoneHash of the source ban being promoted: forwarded, never derived here.

statusChangeTypeHash.derivation: The status-change interaction's interactionTypeHash, supplied by the client; names that a status changed, never which.

producer.why: Holds a client-chosen plain constant, the same as interactionTypeHash; registered as known debt.

plainValueSites.why: Desktop sends the plain constant 'status_change' to mark a status change (#3118).

subscriberHash.derivation: HMAC of the subscriber identifier under the hub's messaging key.

tagHashes.derivation: HMAC blind index of a tag under the hub's index key (blind_index, salt LABEL_BLIND_INDEX_KEY). Not implemented: every writer writes []. Real tokens come with per-hub versioned index keys (#2996 D7, #3025 E5). Registered as HMAC, not debt.
